discrepancies.claim: 'a canonical path/hash/size manifest hash. All 4,999 files under vendor/ contribute to those identity manifests.'
discrepancies.evidence: primary.json has only 20 per-directory file_identity_manifest_sha256 values (no whole-vendor manifest); their file counts sum to 4997. vendor/.project and vendor/.buildpath are counted in summary.vendor_files=4999 but belong to no manifest.
discrepancies.correction: State 4,997 files in 20 per-directory manifests; 2 vendor-root IDE files are counted but unmanifested (or add a whole-vendor manifest).

discrepancies.claim: Legacy Google client version 'Unresolved' with no candidate cited.
discrepancies.correction: Cite as an unadjudicated in-tree user-agent version literal (same mechanism as the 1.1.2 tree's LIBVER); do not silently leave it out. Whether it is the release version remains unproven.

discrepancies.evidence: propel-generator is bundled inside vendor/symfony/vendor/; it is not unrelated, only not proven applicable to Symfony's own files.
